question: Can I exile Lamplight Phoenix from my graveyard to pay for the collect evidence cost of its own triggered ability?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you cannot exile the Phoenix itself to pay that cost.
expected.answer: You can't exile Lamplight Phoenix from your graveyard to pay the collect evidence cost of its triggered ability.
